cases.purpose: Read, Filter, Project and deterministic ordering
cases.sql: SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM customers WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY customer_id

cases.purpose: Nested scalar expression and output alias
cases.sql: SELECT order_id, order_amount + 10 AS adjusted_amount FROM orders WHERE order_amount > 10 ORDER BY order_id

cases.purpose: Binary inner join, filter and project
cases.sql: SELECT customer_name, order_amount FROM customers INNER JOIN orders ON customer_id = order_customer_id WHERE order_amount > 10 ORDER BY order_amount
SELECT customer_name, order_amount FROM customers LEFT JOIN orders ON customer_id = order_customer_id ORDER BY customer_name, order_amount

cases.purpose: Recursive association of three successive joins in one semantic workload
cases.sql: SELECT customer_name, product_name, quantity FROM customers INNER JOIN orders ON customer_id = order_customer_id INNER JOIN order_items ON order_id = item_order_id INNER JOIN products ON product_id = product_id_ref WHERE quantity > 0 ORDER BY customer_name, product_name
SELECT order_customer_id, SUM(order_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE order_amount > 0 GROUP BY order_customer_id HAVING SUM(order_amount) > 20 ORDER BY order_customer_id
SELECT customer_id AS entity_id FROM customers WHERE active = 1 UNION ALL SELECT order_customer_id AS entity_id FROM orders WHERE order_amount > 50
SELECT country_id AS country_key FROM customers UNION SELECT country_id_ref AS country_key FROM countries
SELECT country_id AS country_key FROM customers INTERSECT SELECT country_id_ref AS country_key FROM countries
SELECT country_id_ref AS country_key FROM countries EXCEPT SELECT country_id AS country_key FROM customers WHERE active = 1
SELECT order_id FROM orders ORDER BY order_id LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1
SELECT order_id, order_customer_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_customer_id ORDER BY order_id) AS rn FROM orders ORDER BY order_id
SELECT order_id, CASE WHEN order_amount > 50 THEN 'large' ELSE 'small' END AS size_class FROM orders ORDER BY order_id
SELECT order_id, CAST(order_amount AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS amount_decimal FROM orders ORDER BY order_id

cases.purpose: Named relation binding without assuming a dedicated CTE operator
cases.sql: WITH active_customers AS (SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM customers WHERE active = 1) SELECT customer_id, customer_name FROM active_customers ORDER BY customer_id

cases.purpose: Outer reference and correlated existence semantics
cases.sql: SELECT customer_id FROM customers c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.order_customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.order_amount > 50) ORDER BY customer_id
SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE event_payload IS NULL ORDER BY event_id
SELECT order_id, order_amount * 1.20 AS gross_amount FROM orders ORDER BY order_id
SELECT order_id, DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at) AS order_day FROM orders ORDER BY order_id

cases.purpose: Provider-native JSON function without assumed portable equivalent
cases.sql: SELECT event_id, JSONB_PATH_QUERY_FIRST(CAST(event_payload AS JSONB), '$.kind') AS kind FROM events ORDER BY event_id
SELECT event_id, value FROM events CROSS JOIN UNNEST(event_values) AS t(value) ORDER BY event_id, value
SELECT "customer_id" AS "CustomerId" FROM "customers" ORDER BY "CustomerId"
SELECT order_customer_id, COUNT(order_id) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_customer_id ORDER BY order_customer_id

cases.purpose: Recursive relation semantics intentionally outside VTX2 core
cases.sql: WITH RECURSIVE n(x) AS (SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT x + 1 FROM n WHERE x < 3) SELECT x FROM n ORDER BY x
